headline: Apple reportedly planning to build AI servers again
summary: Two outlets report, citing The Information, that Apple plans to return to building servers for AI work, more than a decade after retiring Xserve. They name different specifics: one a 2029 debut on Apple's own chips, the other a possible partnership with Nvidia.
